conjugation.help.base: Dictionary form: the original, unconjugated form you look up in a dictionary.
conjugation.help.verb.ます形:
Polite form. Used in everyday polite speech.
食べます = (I) eat
conjugation.help.verb.ない形:
Negative form. Says the action does not happen.
食べない = (I) don't eat
conjugation.help.verb.た形:
Past form. Says the action happened.
食べた = (I) ate
conjugation.help.verb.て形:
Connecting form. Joins actions, makes requests (〜てください) and continuous (〜ている).
食べて = eat and...
conjugation.help.verb.可能形:
Potential form. Means can / be able to do.
食べられる = can eat
conjugation.help.verb.意志形:
Volitional form. Means let's do / I will do.
食べよう = let's eat
conjugation.help.verb.命令形:
Imperative form. A blunt command.
食べろ = Eat!
conjugation.help.verb.条件形:
Conditional (ば) form. Means if / provided that.
食べれば = if (you) eat
conjugation.help.verb.受身形:
Passive form. The subject has the action done to them.
食べられる = be eaten
conjugation.help.verb.使役形:
Causative form. Make or let someone do it.
食べさせる = make/let eat
conjugation.help.adj.丁寧形:
Polite form with です.
高いです = it is expensive
conjugation.help.adj.否定形:
Negative form. Says it is not so.
高くない / 静かじゃない = is not
conjugation.help.adj.過去形:
Past form. Says it was so.
高かった / 静かだった = was
conjugation.help.adj.過去否定:
Past negative. Says it was not so.
高くなかった = was not
conjugation.help.adj.て形:
Connecting form. Joins descriptions.
高くて安い… / 静かで… = and
conjugation.help.adj.副詞形:
Adverb form. Describes how an action is done.
高く / 静かに = highly / quietly
conjugation.help.adj.条件形:
Conditional. Means if / provided that.
高ければ / 静かなら = if it is
conjugation.help.adj.たら形:
Conditional (たら). Means if / when it becomes so.
高かったら = if it is expensive
conjugation.help.adj.名詞化:
Turns the adjective into a noun for degree.
高さ = height
conjugation.help.adj.推量形:
Conjecture. Means probably.
高いだろう = it is probably expensive
